The bottle line’s fifteen routines as rung text, routine by routine in MainRoutine’s order, exactly as File → Export / Copy as Text… gives them. Part IV draws every rung and explains it; this is the listing to compare yours against.

MainRoutine

 0 JSR(S1_Run);
 1 JSR(S2_Dwell);
 2 JSR(S4_Registers);
 3 JSR(S5_Fill);
 4 JSR(S6_Supply);
 5 JSR(S7_Cap);
 6 JSR(S8_Sort);
 7 JSR(S9_Count);

10 JSR(S12_Pack);
11 JSR(S14_Hazard);
12 JSR(S15_Inspect);
13 JSR(S13_Mix);
14 JSR(S3_Index);
